personal.preferred_title: Senior Data Engineer | Python, SQL, AWS Data Pipelines & Production Data Operations

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across Python, SQL, AWS data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data operations, data ingestion, transformation, validation, data quality, lineage-style documentation, monitoring, CI/CD concepts, and production support. Strong background designing and maintaining enterprise-scale data workflows, reconciling pipeline outputs, optimizing SQL/reporting layers, documenting data flows, and supporting reliable operational analytics in regulated enterprise environments. Best aligned to remote data engineering roles requiring Python, SQL, cloud or hybrid data operations, orchestration, validation, monitoring, data reliability, and production pipeline support; GCP/Dataflow, formal public-sector delivery, and cloud certifications are positioned carefully as adjacent or non-claimed areas.

Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, indexes, views, partitioning patterns, and reporting data models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware processing.
Collaborated with infrastructure, application, analytics, and business teams to troubleshoot production data issues, improve monitoring practices, and deliver reliable data products.
